s0101.literal: Spring, first month, guichou day, in year three: Ministerial Aide and concurrent Grand Compiler Xu Ling was made Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing.
s0101.idiomatic: On guichou day in the first month of year 3 Xu Ling, ministerial aide and grand compiler, was made ministerial aide of the Masters of Writing.

s0102.literal: On xinyou day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
s0102.idiomatic: On xinyou day the emperor sacrificed in person at the southern suburb.

s0103.literal: On xinwei day he personally sacrificed at the northern suburb.
s0103.idiomatic: On xinwei day he sacrificed in person at the northern suburb.

s0104.literal: Second month, xinsi day: the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
s0104.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the second month the emperor sacrificed in person at the Bright Hall.

s0105.literal: On dingyou day he personally plowed the sacred field.
s0105.idiomatic: On dingyou day he plowed the sacred field in person.

s0106.literal: Third month, dingchou day: a general amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
s0106.idiomatic: On dingchou day in the third month a general amnesty was proclaimed.

s0107.literal: From Tiankang year one through Taijian year one, overdue army grain, salaries, and summer levies not yet paid in are all remitted.
s0107.idiomatic: From Tiankang year 1 through Taijian year 1 all overdue army grain, salaries, and summer levies still unpaid are remitted.

s0108.literal: Another edict said: "Kinsmen of criminals in treason who fled to other regions are all permitted to return and confess;
s0108.idiomatic: A further edict said: "Kin of traitors who fled abroad may all return and confess;

s0109.literal: those now in bonds may, according to measure, be released;
s0109.idiomatic: those now imprisoned may be released as the case allows;

s0110.literal: those who have dwellings are also to have them restored.
s0110.idiomatic: those who own dwellings shall have them restored as well.

s0111.literal: Summer, fourth month, renchen day: Qi sent envoys on a friendly visit.
s0111.idiomatic: On renchen day in the fourth month of summer Qi sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0112.literal: Fifth month, wushen day: the Metal Star appeared in daylight.
s0112.idiomatic: On wushen day in the fifth month Venus was seen by day.

s0113.literal: On xinhai day Liaodong, Silla, Dandan, Tianzhu, Panpan, and other states all sent envoys presenting local products.
s0113.idiomatic: On xinhai day Liaodong, Silla, Dandan, Tianzhu, Panpan, and other states all sent tribute envoys.

s0114.literal: Sixth month, dinghai day: Prince of Jiangyin Xiao Jiqing was removed from office for crime.
s0114.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the sixth month Xiao Jiqing, Prince of Jiangyin, was dismissed for crime.

s0115.literal: On jiachen day East Center General and Secretariat Adviser of the Changsha princely establishment Xiao Yi was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangyin.
s0115.idiomatic: On jiachen day Xiao Yi, east center general and adviser of the Changsha princely establishment, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangyin.

s0116.literal: Autumn, eighth month, xinchou day: the crown prince personally performed the libation at the Imperial Academy; the two tutors, libationer, and those below
s0116.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the eighth month of autumn the crown prince performed the libation at the Imperial Academy in person; the two tutors, libationer, and those below

s0118.literal: were given silk gifts in varying measure.
s0118.idiomatic: received silk gifts in varying measure.

s0120.literal: Ninth month, guiyou day: the Metal Star appeared in daylight.
s0120.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the ninth month Venus was seen by day.

s0121.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiashen day: the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the imperial temple.
s0121.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the tenth month of winter the emperor sacrificed in person at the ancestral temple.

s0122.literal: On yiyou day Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.
s0122.idiomatic: On yiyou day Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0123.literal: On jihai day Dandan sent envoys presenting local products.
s0123.idiomatic: On jihai day Dandan sent tribute envoys.

s0124.literal: Twelfth month, renchen day: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Minister of Works Zhang Zhaoda died.
s0124.idiomatic: On renchen day in the twelfth month Zhang Zhaoda, grand general of chariots and cavalry and minister of works, died.

s0125.literal: Spring, first month, jingwu day, in year four: Cloud-Banner General and Inspector of Jiangzhou, Prince of Shixing Shuling, was made Inspector of Xiangzhou and advanced in title to Pacify South General;
s0125.idiomatic: On jingwu day in the first month of year 4 Prince Shuling of Shixing, cloud-banner general and inspector of Jiangzhou, was made inspector of Xiangzhou and promoted to pacify south general;

s0126.literal: East Center General and Administrator of Wu commandery, Prince of Changsha Shujian, was made Manifest Firmness General and Inspector of Jiangzhou;
s0126.idiomatic: Shujian, Prince of Changsha, east center general and administrator of Wu, was made manifest firmness general and inspector of Jiangzhou;

s0127.literal: Ministerial Aide and concurrent Grand Compiler Xu Ling was made Left Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing;
s0127.idiomatic: Xu Ling, ministerial aide and grand compiler, became left ministerial aide;

s0128.literal: Secretariat Supervisor Wang Li was made Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing.
s0128.idiomatic: Wang Li, secretariat supervisor, became right ministerial aide.

s0129.literal: On gengshen day Administrator of Danyang, Prince of Hengyang Boxin, was made Trustworthy Prestige General and Central Protector.
s0129.idiomatic: On gengshen day Boxin, Prince of Hengyang and administrator of Danyang, was made trustworthy prestige general and central protector.

s0130.literal: On gengwu day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the imperial temple.
s0130.idiomatic: On gengwu day the emperor sacrificed in person at the ancestral temple.

s0131.literal: Second month, yiyou day: the prince Shuqing was established as Prince of Jian'an, appointed East Center General and Inspector of East Yangzhou.
s0131.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the second month Prince Shuqing was made Prince of Jian'an, east center general and inspector of East Yangzhou.

s0132.literal: Third month, renzi day: Regular Attendant Sun Yang was made Pacify West General and Inspector of Jingzhou.
s0132.idiomatic: On renzi day in the third month Sun Yang, regular attendant, was made pacify west general and inspector of Jingzhou.

s0133.literal: On yichou day Funan and Linyi both sent envoys coming to present local products.
s0133.idiomatic: On yichou day Funan and Linyi both sent envoys with tribute.

s0134.literal: Summer, fourth month, wuzi day: Central Authority Grand General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Huang Faqu was made Campaign South Grand General and Inspector of South Yuzhou.
s0134.idiomatic: On wuzi day in the fourth month of summer Huang Faqu, central authority grand general, was made campaign south grand general and inspector of South Yuzhou.

s0135.literal: Fifth month, guimao day: Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing Wang Li died.
s0135.idiomatic: On guimao day in the fifth month Wang Li, right ministerial aide, died.

s0136.literal: Sixth month, xinsi day: Palace Attendant, Garrison Right General, and Right Grand Master of the Palace Du Ling died.
s0136.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the sixth month Du Ling, palace attendant, garrison right general, and right grand master of the palace, died.

s0137.literal: Autumn, eighth month, xinwei day: Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.
s0137.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the eighth month of autumn Northern Zhou sent envoys on a friendly visit.

s0138.literal: On dingchou day auspicious clouds appeared.
s0138.idiomatic: On dingchou day auspicious clouds appeared.

s0139.literal: On wuyin day an edict said: "A state's great affairs receive the victim's flesh and raise arms.
s0139.idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict said: "The great affairs of the state take the victim's flesh and raise arms.

s0140.literal: When the army goes forth it follows the statutes and receives the plan at the temple, thereby to settle the nine domains and complete the seven virtues.
s0140.idiomatic: When troops march they follow the statutes and receive the plan at the temple, to settle the nine realms and fulfill the seven martial virtues.

s0141.literal: In recent times We have swept away the crowd of filth and cleared the various Xia—this too is the fierce tiger soldiers' exertion of force, and also the planning from within the tent.
s0141.idiomatic: Lately We have swept away rebels and cleared the heartland—this is the fierce soldiers' labor and the counsel of the tent as well.

s0142.literal: Though the left lapel has been subdued and weapons stored, the Xiongnu chieftain has come to audience and frontier posts are without alarm;
s0142.idiomatic: Though the northern foe has been beaten and arms laid by, chieftains have come to court and the frontier is quiet;

s0143.literal: yet not to teach the people war is called abandoning them; benevolence surely has courage—do not forget martial preparation.
s0143.idiomatic: yet not to teach the people war is to abandon them; benevolence must have courage—do not forget readiness for arms.

s0144.literal: The Pan River tradition transmitted hidden stratagems; Gucheng granted divine talismans; Wen Shu hung forth military regulations; Meng De spoke much of military strategy.
s0144.idiomatic: By Pan River the hidden stratagems were handed down; at Gucheng divine talismans were granted; Emperor Guangwu set military rules in place; Cao Cao spoke often of strategy.

s0145.literal: We are ashamed that dark accord is lacking, yet all have been spread before Us.
s0145.idiomatic: We are ashamed our own grasp is dim, yet We have read them all.

s0146.literal: Moreover in former days We supervised the army and have fully tasted the ranks; with Qi it was seven paces, with Su three drums—these came from Our own breast and may be told at a gesture.
s0146.idiomatic: Moreover We once commanded armies and have stood in the ranks; seven paces with Qi, three drums with Su—these came from Our own breast and can be told at a gesture.

s0147.literal: Now all are set down in regulations, thirteen categories in all; they should at once be promulgated as the everlasting standard.
s0147.idiomatic: Now they are set down in thirteen articles; promulgate them at once as the lasting standard.

s0148.literal: " On yiwei day an edict halted collection of overdue rent in Xiang and Jiang provinces; for the fifteen counties of Wuxi and others with wandering people, their corvée levies are also remitted.
s0148.idiomatic: " On yiwei day an edict stopped collection of overdue rent in Xiang and Jiang; for fifteen counties including Wuxi, where people were adrift, corvée was also remitted.

s0150.literal: Ninth month, gengzi first day, Editorial footnote marker 7. there was an eclipse of the sun.
s0150.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, gengzi, [7] there was a solar eclipse.

s0151.literal: On xinhai day a general amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
s0151.idiomatic: On xinhai day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

s0152.literal: Another edict said: "To raise the good and follow remonstrance is the enlightened ruler's bright rule;
s0152.idiomatic: A further edict said: "To raise the good and heed remonstrance is the enlightened ruler's law;

s0153.literal: to advance the worthy and present words is the minister's model statute.
s0153.idiomatic: to advance the worthy and speak plainly is the minister's model.

s0154.literal: We, of slight virtue, have succeeded and guard the precious chart; though the age inherits long peace, government is not uniformly settled.
s0154.idiomatic: We are slight in virtue and guard the sacred chart; though the age inherits peace, rule is not yet uniform.

s0155.literal: Distinguishing offices and dividing duties, We eat before dawn and dress early;
s0155.idiomatic: Sorting offices and duties, We rise before dawn and dress early;

s0156.literal: at Our side remonstrating ministers are lacking, below there are no tribute scholars.
s0156.idiomatic: yet at Our side remonstrating ministers are few, and below there are no scholars offering counsel.

s0157.literal: How is it so lacking—few can stand straight and speak hard?
s0157.idiomatic: How can it be so empty—who can stand straight and speak hard?

s0158.literal: Is it that We alone turn the pivot and do not recommend honest words?
s0158.idiomatic: Is it that We alone turn the pivot and hear no honest words?

s0159.literal: The drum at the public carriage rarely discusses gain and loss;
s0159.idiomatic: The drum at the public carriage rarely hears of gain and loss;

s0160.literal: the stone before the image hall seldom states yes or no.
s0160.idiomatic: the stone before the image hall seldom records yes or no.

s0161.literal: Zhu Yun breaking the railing—truly We do not meet it;
s0161.idiomatic: Zhu Yun smashing the railing—We seldom meet such men;

s0162.literal: Qin Xi touching the pillar—again it is hard to obtain.
s0162.idiomatic: Qin Xi touching the pillar—again such men are hard to find.

s0163.literal: As for wearing coarse cloth to audience, carrying a mat to wander, or being unrivaled in age, or exceptional in youth, striving for the age yet not meeting their time, with none at left or right to praise them, black sable worn out, Editorial footnote marker 8. gold nearly spent, ending in stagnation and drowning, Editorial footnote marker 9. one may sigh greatly.
s0163.idiomatic: Men in coarse cloth at audience, mat on back wandering the roads, unrivaled in age or rare in youth, striving yet unmatched, with none to praise them, black sable worn through [8], gold nearly gone [9], ending drowned in neglect—this makes one sigh deeply.

s0164.literal: Again the noble are the hundred officials, the lowly have ten ranks; craft and clumsiness race together, encouragement and restraint are not divided; street songs merely crowd, court debate is thus lacking.
s0164.idiomatic: Again, the high are the hundred offices, the low have ten ranks; skilled and clumsy race alike, reward and restraint are not sorted; street songs crowd while court debate fails.

s0165.literal: Truly it is Our lack of clarity, while the age has no presenting and replacing.
s0165.idiomatic: Truly Our light is dim, while the age offers no presenting and replacing.

s0166.literal: Long speaking of utmost government—how is it so far off?
s0166.idiomatic: Long We speak of perfect rule—how far it still seems!

s0167.literal: Without, let it be announced to civil and military: all who hold office, where custom and transformation differ, court government is tangled and corrupt—let them with upright color and straight words offend without hiding.
s0167.idiomatic: Let this be announced to civil and military alike: all in office, wherever custom fails or government rots, speak with upright color and straight words and hide nothing.

s0168.literal: Moreover each is to recommend those he knows, and according to talent let them be clearly tested.
s0168.idiomatic: Each is also to recommend those he knows and let talent be tested in the open.

s0169.literal: Those who govern with integrity or filth, able or unable in office, are to speak plainly in separation; wait for this dismissal and promotion.
s0169.idiomatic: Report who governs clean or corrupt, who serves well or ill; wait on Us for promotion and dismissal.

s0170.literal: On jingyin day the former Grand Commandant Xu Du, Equal in Rank to the Three Dukes Du Ling, and Equal in Rank to the Three Dukes Cheng Lingxi were granted sacrifice in the Founder's temple court; the former General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang Zhaoda in Emperor Wen's temple court.
s0170.idiomatic: On jingyin day Xu Du, former grand commandant; Du Ling and Cheng Lingxi, equals in rank to the three dukes; were granted sacrifice in the Founder's temple court; Zhang Zhaoda, former general of chariots and cavalry, in Emperor Wen's temple court.

s0172.literal: Winter, tenth month, yiyou day: the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the imperial temple.
s0172.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the tenth month of winter the emperor sacrificed in person at the ancestral temple.

s0173.literal: On wuxu day General Who Garrisons South and Inspector of Guangzhou Shen Ke was made Commandant of the Palace Guard.
s0173.idiomatic: On wuxu day Shen Ke, general who garrisons south and inspector of Guangzhou, was made commandant of the palace guard.

s0174.idiomatic: On the night of jihai day in the eleventh month there was an earthquake.

s0176.literal: Intercalary month, xinwei day, an edict said: "Guru is rich and broad, comparable to the Jing and Yellow rivers; Bowang is a gateway pass, heaven's barrier stern and steep; Dragon Mountain points south, Ox Ford faces north; opposite the remnant city of Xiong Yi, near the old rampart of Quan Cong; good fields and fine mulberry, plots and ditches facing one another, joined houses and high eaves, farm paths like brocade.
s0176.idiomatic: On xinwei day in the intercalary month an edict said: "Guru is rich and wide, a match for the Jing and Yellow rivers; Bowang is a gateway, heaven's barrier steep; Dragon Mountain points south, Ox Ford north; it faces Xiong Yi's remnant city and nears Quan Cong's old wall; good fields and fine mulberry, ditches in rows, rooflines joined, farm paths like brocade.

s0177.literal: From the Liang season's end, military calamity came again and again and decay was nearly complete; though We have sought leniency, it is not yet recovered; within a hand's reach of the capital precinct it should be abundantly prosperous.
s0177.idiomatic: Since the end of Liang war came again and again and the land was nearly ruined; though We have been lenient, it is not yet restored; so close to the capital it should flourish again.

s0178.literal: Moreover under the various generals many lodge above and below; army and people mixed in custom are extremely wasteful.
s0178.idiomatic: Moreover many followers of the generals lodge high and low; army and people mixed in one custom waste the land terribly.

s0179.literal: From now on those dismissed from office are permitted to leave part of their followers;
s0179.idiomatic: From now on men dismissed from office may leave part of their followers behind;

s0180.literal: those already beyond the river are also ordered to be brought back and all are to dwell in the ferry districts of South Province.
s0180.idiomatic: those already beyond the river are also to be brought back and settled in South Province's ferry districts.

s0181.literal: Whether goods are exchanged or not, market appraisals are not demanded;
s0181.idiomatic: Whether goods are traded or not, market tax is not demanded;

s0182.literal: opening waste and clearing wild land also halts rent and tax.
s0182.idiomatic: opening waste and clearing wild land is also free of rent and tax.

s0183.literal: The court sends one garrison inspector who, together with the inspector and ferry master, clearly inspects and checks, assigns land and fields, and each establishes a station."
s0183.idiomatic: The court sends one garrison inspector who, with the provincial inspector and ferry master, inspects clearly, assigns fields, and establishes stations for each group."

s0184.literal: Twelfth month, renyin day: sweet dew fell in the Pleasure Tour Park.
s0184.idiomatic: On renyin day in the twelfth month sweet dew fell in the Pleasure Tour Park.

s0185.literal: On jiachen day the imperial carriage visited the Pleasure Tour Park, gathered sweet dew, and feasted the host of ministers.
s0185.idiomatic: On jiachen day the emperor visited the Pleasure Tour Park, gathered sweet dew, and feasted his ministers.

s0186.literal: On dingmao day an edict said: "In the Liang season's end, military fire came again and again; Chenghua was burned and swept, and for a time there was no surviving structure.
s0186.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict said: "At the end of Liang war came again and again; the eastern palace was burned away and nothing survived.

s0187.literal: The precious mandate is newly received and will soon be two reigns; military affairs have been frequent and We have had no leisure to repair.
s0187.idiomatic: The mandate is newly ours and nearly two reigns have passed; campaigns have been constant and We have not yet repaired.

s0188.literal: Now corvée labor is somewhat free and rafters and pillars are in prospect; next year We open the founding and begin building the eastern palace; provisionally appoint Acting Minister for Starting Construction and Grand Master of Works to supervise the work."
s0188.idiomatic: Now labor is somewhat free and timber is at hand; next year We begin the eastern palace; appoint for the time being an acting minister for starting construction and grand master of works to oversee the building."

s0189.literal: Spring, first month, guiyou day, in year five: Campaign North Grand General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of South Xuzhou Chunyu Liang was made Central Authority Grand General;
s0189.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the first month of year 5 Chunyu Liang, campaign north grand general and inspector of South Xuzhou, was made central authority grand general;

s0190.literal: Manifest Grace General and Prince of Yuzhang Shuying was made Inspector of South Xuzhou and advanced in title to Pacify North General;
s0190.idiomatic: Shuying, Prince of Yuzhang and manifest grace general, was made inspector of South Xuzhou and promoted to pacify north general;

s0191.literal: Minister of Personnel and Commandant of Horse for the Consort Shen Junli was made Right Ministerial Aide of the Masters of Writing and concurrent Minister of Personnel.
s0191.idiomatic: Shen Junli, minister of personnel and commandant of horse for the consort, became right ministerial aide and kept the ministry of personnel.

s0192.literal: On xinsi day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
s0192.idiomatic: On xinsi day the emperor sacrificed in person at the southern suburb.

s0193.literal: On jiawu day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the imperial temple.
s0193.idiomatic: On jiawu day the emperor sacrificed in person at the ancestral temple.

s0194.literal: Second month, xinchou day: the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the Bright Hall.
s0194.idiomatic: On xinchou day in the second month the emperor sacrificed in person at the Bright Hall.

s0195.literal: On yimao night white vapor like a rainbow ran from the north through the Purple Palace of the Northern Dipper.
s0195.idiomatic: On the night of yimao day white vapor like a rainbow ran from the north through the Purple Palace and the Northern Dipper.

s0196.literal: Third month, renwu day: the various armies were separately ordered on the northern campaign; Garrison Front General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Wu Mingche was made Area Commander over the punitive expedition's military affairs.
s0196.idiomatic: On renwu day in the third month the armies were ordered north; Wu Mingche, garrison front general with a mansion equal to the three dukes, was made area commander over the punitive campaign.

s0197.literal: On jingxu day West Hengzhou presented a horse that had grown horns.
s0197.idiomatic: On jingxu day West Hengzhou presented a horse that had grown horns.

s0198.literal: On jichou day the imperial grandson Yin was born; civil and military within and without were given silk gifts in varying measure; those who were heirs to their fathers were granted one step of nobility.
s0198.idiomatic: On jichou day the imperial grandson Yin was born; officials civil and military received silk in varying measure; heirs received one step of nobility.

s0199.literal: Great Commander of the Northern Punitive Expedition Wu Mingche commanded a host of one hundred thousand and set out from Baixia.
s0199.idiomatic: Wu Mingche, great commander of the northern punitive expedition, took a host of one hundred thousand and marched from Baixia.

s0200.literal: Summer, fourth month, guimao day: former Administrator of Ba commandery Lu Guangda captured Qi's Great Xian fortress.
s0200.idiomatic: On guimao day in the fourth month of summer Lu Guangda, former administrator of Ba, captured Qi's Great Xian fortress.
